query: Audit the home page of my SaaS site (a running local build at http://localhost:3000). Do a first-principles review and tell me where it can be improved.
expected_behavior: States the page job and task path from evidence, and labels important unknowns rather than fabricating focus
For the marketing home page, identifies the value promise and checks whether the page delivers it; ranks the strongest evidence-backed gap rather than assuming it is the only important fix
Delegates each lens to the skill that owns it (copy to /copywriter, conversion and CTA to /friction, craft to /design, function to /audit and /test, SEO to /seo) instead of re-teaching them
Ranks the highest-impact change against the page job, while allowing several distinct user actions when the workflow needs them
Produces a ranked findings sheet using add / change / rearrange / remove, and does not declare the page done on a renamed button
